calibration_assignment: last two remaining training matches; never outer validation matches
match_weighting: each coefficient-fit match receives equal total weight; each calibration match receives equal total weight
feature_target: provider H/A ownership conditional on detected nearby geometry, not explicit reception annotations
reference_mask: eligible observed geometry and known H/A only; null is never D
final_fit_assignment: first ten development matches fit coefficients; last two calibrate temperature
